web/src/features/plan: The plan page draws the project's storyboard as the browser imports and resolves it, re-timed on each hot update of storyboard.ts.
web/src/features/projects: A project's plan row counts its signed scenes, which only a resolved storyboard can say, and only the browser resolves one: the app server never imports a project's TypeScript.
web/src/features/decisions: The decisions screen walks a project's decisions in story order and shows the line each is for, which only the storyboard the browser resolves can say.
